strengths: Novel framing of text-to-CAD as an interactive problem with proactive clarification—addressing a practically important issue of under-specified/inconsistent specifications
High-quality text-to-CadQuery dataset (10K samples) with thoughtful annotation pipeline: multi-modal conditioning (images + code), leakage/completeness checks, 80%+ automated
Strong empirical results: 79.9% reduction in mean Chamfer distance vs Claude Sonnet 4.5 on ambiguous prompts; invalidity ratio reduced from 4.8% to 0.9% using only 1.6K fine-tuning samples

Comprehensive evaluation: multiple baselines, both LLM and human evaluation, ablation studies (interaction protocols), out-of-distribution generalization tests, detailed failure analysis showing 99.4% of failures are under-clarification
Clear presentation with good motivation, informative case studies, and extensive appendices enabling reproducibility
Dataset creation pipeline avoids JSON minimalism of prior work (Text2CAD) by conditioning on CadQuery code, showing advantages in clarity and human-likeness
weaknesses: Heavy reliance on synthetic ambiguity: two types (under-specified, conflicting) generated by GPT-5-mini perturbation may not reflect real-world diversity; unknown if other ambiguity types exist in practice

Limited real-world validation: human evaluation uses only 100 examples with artificial setup (annotators provided original unambiguous prompt); no evaluation on naturally-occurring ambiguous prompts from real users
Circular evaluation dependencies: data generation and completeness checks both use GPT-5-mini, potentially biasing descriptions toward what this specific model can handle; systematic bias risk
LLM-based user simulation may not reflect real user behavior; paper assumes users provide correct answers to clarification questions, which is unvalidated assumption

Misleading framing of training efficiency: '1.6K samples' come from curated 10K dataset with 20% requiring manual expert intervention; the headline obscures data quality as the real driver of performance

Limited technical novelty: agentic SFT is standard supervised fine-tuning with JSON formatting; MDP formulation is straightforward; main contribution is application to a domain rather than methodological innovation
Narrow scope: text-to-CAD is a specialized domain with unclear transferability of insights to other interactive AI systems or ambiguity resolution problems
Insufficient analysis of synthetic ambiguity selection: CD ratio filter (≥10) is arbitrary; no ablation on realism of perturbations or their distribution compared to natural ambiguities
